variantArt._note: The unipolar (centre-tapped, 28BYJ-48 class) motor the engine models by default (params.wiring unset or 'unipolar'): coil1-coil4 and the common com, five wires.

_note: 4-wire bipolar stepper. For unipolar (5/6-wire), center taps would need additional terminals. bw-board models 4-wire bipolar. Terminals here are the BIPOLAR four-wire motor (two coils, H-bridge driven). The engine models both wirings behind params.wiring and defaults to unipolar (coil1-coil4 + com, five wires, centre-tapped) — see variants.
